court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: TR CMP No. 107 of 2024 and CMP No. 2366 of 2024
advocates: For Petitioner: Ms. Banumathi. M for Mr. P.C. Ramesh
For Respondent: Not Ready in Notice
prayer: Prayer: This Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition filed under Section 24 of Civil Procedure Code, to withdraw H.M.O.P. No. 3813 of 2023 from the file of the 1st Additional Family Court at Chennai and to transfer the same to the Sub Court, Thiruthuraipoondi Taluk, Thiruvarur District.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr A.D. Maria Clete, J.:— When the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition and she has also made an endorsement in the petition to that effect.

2. In view of the submission and endorsement made by the learned counsel for petitioner, this Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. Consequently, connected C.M.P. No. 2366 of 2024 is closed. There shall be no order as to costs.
